definition: An informal, physically mobile black market that relocates on a rotating schedule broadcast only through trusted Diaspora nodes. No fixed location, no permanent stalls — vendors fold up and vanish within minutes of the window closing.
origin: Underworld logistics terminology, referencing the way the market 'folds' out of existence.
usage: Used by the Gray Zone and lower Old Harbor residents, fixers, and anyone who needs to buy things that don't officially exist.
example: The only place you'd find unclipped Zheng-Dao mods was the fold market — if you knew which node to listen to.
